hindi: पाँच सौ धनुष की दूरी पर दुर्ग स्थापित करके युद्ध में उतरे, अथवा भूमि के अनुसार।
english: Having set up the fort at a distance of five hundred bows, he should go to battle; or according to the lie of the ground.
notes: durga here is the fortified base from which battle is joined; dhanuḥ 'bow' is the unit of length defined in 10.5.6. The 'five hundred bows' are measured from the battlefield.

words.gloss: in a place out of sight
having set free, having moved out

hindi: सेनापति और नायक, जिसके मुख्य अधिकारी अलग-अलग नियुक्त हों ऐसी सेना को शत्रु की दृष्टि से ओझल स्थान में निकालकर, उसे व्यूह में खड़ा करें।
english: The commander-in-chief and the leader should array the army, with its chiefs assigned to separate units, after moving it out in a place out of sight (of the enemy).
notes: acakṣur-viṣaye: literally 'in a region not within eyesight'; the enemy is implied. mokṣayitvā 'having released' taken as moving the troops out (of the camp) to the ground.

words.gloss: at an interval of one śama
at an interval of three śamas
at an interval of five śamas

hindi: एक शम के अन्तर पर पैदल सैनिक को खड़ा करे, तीन शम के अन्तर पर घोड़े को, पाँच शम के अन्तर पर रथ अथवा हाथी को।
english: He should station a foot-soldier at an interval of one śama, a horse at an interval of three śamas, a chariot or an elephant at an interval of five śamas.
notes: śama: a measure of length (a unit of the aṅgula scale); kept untranslated.

hindi: अथवा दुगुने या तिगुने अन्तर पर व्यूह बनाए।
english: Or he should array (them) with double or triple the interval.

hindi: इस प्रकार सुखपूर्वक, बिना भीड़-भाड़ के युद्ध कर सकेगी।
english: Thus one would fight at ease, without crowding.

hindi: पाँच अरत्नि का एक धनुष होता है।
english: A bow (the measure) is five aratnis (cubits).
notes: aratni: the cubit, elbow to fingertip.

hindi: उतने स्थान में धनुर्धर को खड़ा करे, तीन धनुष में घोड़े को, पाँच धनुष में रथ अथवा हाथी को।
english: In that (space of one bow) he should station an archer, a horse in three bows, a chariot or an elephant in five bows.

hindi: पक्ष, कक्ष और उरस्य के बीच सेना-विभागों का सन्धि-स्थान पाँच धनुष का हो।
english: The junction between the divisions of the wings, the flanks and the centre (breast) is five bows.
notes: pakṣa = wing, kakṣa = flank, urasya = centre (breast) of the array; these three are used throughout the chapter.

hindi: एक घोड़े के लिए तीन पुरुष आगे लड़ने वाले योद्धा हों।
english: For a horse, three men are the fighters in front.
notes: pratiyoddhṛ: literally 'counter-fighter'; here the foot-soldiers who fight in front of (to cover) a horse, as against the pāda-gopa 'foot-guards' of 10.5.11.

hindi: रथ अथवा हाथी के लिए पन्द्रह पुरुष, और पाँच घोड़े।
english: Fifteen for a chariot or an elephant, and five horses.

hindi: घोड़ों, रथों और हाथियों के लिए उतने ही पाद-गोप नियुक्त किए जाएँ।
english: As many foot-guards should be assigned for the horses, chariots and elephants.
notes: pāda-gopa: foot-soldiers guarding the feet (the base) of a horse, chariot or elephant.

hindi: रथों के तीन त्रिक की एक टुकड़ी को उरस्य में खड़ा करे, और उतनी ही कक्ष और पक्ष में दोनों ओर।
english: He should station a division of three triads of chariots as the centre, and as many as flank and wing on both sides.
notes: Three triads = nine chariots in the centre; the same in each flank and each wing gives the 45 chariots of 10.5.13.

hindi: इस प्रकार रथ-व्यूह में पैंतालीस रथ होते हैं, दो सौ पच्चीस घोड़े, छह सौ पचहत्तर पुरुष आगे लड़ने वाले योद्धा, और उतने ही पाद-गोप।
english: Thus in the chariot array there are forty-five chariots, two hundred and twenty-five horses, six hundred and seventy-five men as fighters in front, and as many foot-guards.

text_flags.why: pratiyodhāraḥ is not a valid form; nom. pl. of pratiyoddhṛ is pratiyoddhāraḥ as in 10.5.9; probable typo (dropped d).

notes: Counts follow 10.5.9-12: 45 chariots x 5 horses = 225; 45 x 15 men = 675.

hindi: यह सम-व्यूह है।
english: This is the even array (sama-vyūha).
notes: sama-vyūha: the array in which wings, flanks and centre are equal in number (contrast 10.5.17).

hindi: उसकी वृद्धि दो-दो रथ की होती है, इक्कीस रथ तक।
english: Its increase is by two chariots each time, up to twenty-one chariots.

words.gloss: basic forms of the even array

hindi: इस प्रकार सम-व्यूह की दस ओज अर्थात् विषम संख्या वाली प्रकृतियाँ होती हैं।
english: Thus there are ten odd-numbered basic forms of the even array.
notes: ojā = 'odd' (uneven in number): the centre has 3, 5, 7 ... 21 chariots, ten forms. prakṛti here means 'basic form' of the array, not the constituent element of the glossary.

hindi: पक्ष, कक्ष और उरस्य की संख्या परस्पर विषम होने पर विषम-व्यूह होता है।
english: When the wings, flanks and centre are unequal in number among themselves, it is the uneven array (viṣama-vyūha).

hindi: उसकी भी वृद्धि दो-दो रथ की होती है, इक्कीस रथ तक।
english: Its increase too is by two chariots each time, up to twenty-one chariots.

words.gloss: basic forms of the uneven array

hindi: इस प्रकार विषम-व्यूह की दस ओज अर्थात् विषम संख्या वाली प्रकृतियाँ होती हैं।
english: Thus there are ten odd-numbered basic forms of the uneven array.

hindi: इसके बाद सैनिकों का जो भाग व्यूह से बचे, उसे आवाप बनाना चाहिए।
english: After this, the remainder of the troops beyond the array should be made the āvāpa (the surplus addition).
notes: āvāpa, literally 'what is thrown in': the troops added beyond the standard array; kept in Sanskrit, with pratyāvāpa, anvāvāpa, atyāvāpa in 10.5.25-28. vyūha-śeṣam taken as accusative in apposition to the subject's content ('the remainder ... as āvāpa'); it could also be read as the object of an implied verb.

hindi: रथों के दो तिहाई भाग को अंगों में आवाप के रूप में लगाए, शेष को उरस्य में खड़ा करे।
english: He should add two-thirds of the chariots as surplus in the limbs (wings and flanks); the rest he should station in the centre.

hindi: इस प्रकार रथों का आवाप एक तिहाई कम करके बनाना चाहिए।
english: Thus the surplus of chariots should be made less by one third.
notes: Sense disputed: taken as 'the āvāpa is to be made with a third less (in the centre than in the limbs)'. Confidence medium on the exact arithmetic.

hindi: उसी से हाथियों और घोड़ों का आवाप समझ लेना चाहिए।
english: By that the surplus of elephants and of horses is explained.

hindi: जब तक वह घोड़ों, रथों और हाथियों के लिए युद्ध में भीड़-भाड़ न उत्पन्न करे, तब तक ही आवाप बनाना चाहिए।
english: The surplus should be made (only) so long as it does not cause crowding in battle for the horses, chariots and elephants.

text_flags.why: sambādhanm is not a Sanskrit form (stray n before m in the e-text); acc. sg. sambādham fits 'na kuryāt'.

notes: The e-text's dot after yāvad joins it to the compound; yāvat is the correlative of tāvat and is split off here.

hindi: दण्ड की अधिकता आवाप है।
english: A preponderance of the army is āvāpa (surplus addition).
notes: daṇḍa = army, as in the glossary; here the regular troops as opposed to infantry alone (10.5.26).

hindi: पैदल सेना की अधिकता प्रत्यावाप है।
english: A preponderance of infantry is pratyāvāpa (counter-surplus).

text_flags.why: metathesis in the e-text; the term is pratyāvāpa (prati + āvāpa), as in 10.5.29 pratyāvāpāc.

hindi: किसी एक अंग की अधिकता अन्वावाप है।
english: A preponderance of one arm (of the army) is anvāvāpa (after-surplus).

hindi: दूष्य सैनिकों की अधिकता अत्यावाप है।
english: A preponderance of the treasonable (troops) is atyāvāpa (excess-surplus).
notes: dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary): unreliable troops.

hindi: सैनिकों का आवाप शत्रु के आवाप और प्रत्यावाप की तुलना में चौगुने से लेकर आठगुने तक हो, अथवा अपने साधनों के अनुसार।
english: The surplus of troops should be from fourfold up to eightfold compared with the enemy's surplus and counter-surplus, or according to one's resources.
notes: The ablatives para-āvāpāt and pratyāvāpāt are taken as the standard of comparison for catur-guṇāt ... ā aṣṭa-guṇāt.

hindi: रथ-व्यूह से हस्ति-व्यूह समझ लेना चाहिए।
english: By the chariot array the elephant array is explained.

hindi: अथवा हाथियों, रथों और घोड़ों का मिश्रित व्यूह: चक्र के सिरों पर हाथी, पार्श्वों में घोड़े, उरस्य में रथ।
english: Or a mixed (array) of elephants, chariots and horses: elephants at the extremities, horses on the two sides, chariots in the centre.
notes: cakra-anta 'wheel-end': the outer ends of the array; literal rendering kept.

hindi: उरस्य हाथियों का, दोनों कक्ष रथों के, दोनों पक्ष घोड़ों के — यह मध्य-भेदी व्यूह है।
english: The centre of elephants, the two flanks of chariots, the two wings of horses: this is the 'breaker of the middle' (madhya-bhedī).

hindi: इसका उलटा अन्त-भेदी व्यूह है।
english: The reverse (arrangement) is the 'breaker of the ends' (anta-bhedī).

hindi: किन्तु केवल हाथियों का शुद्ध व्यूह: उरस्य कवचधारी युद्ध-हाथियों का, पिछला भाग सवारी के हाथियों का, दोनों सिरे दुष्ट हाथियों के।
english: But the pure (array) of elephants alone: the centre of armoured elephants, the rear of riding elephants, the two tips of vicious elephants.
notes: sāmnāhya 'fitted with armour (sannāha)', aupavāhya 'for riding', vyāla 'vicious, untamed': the three classes of elephants.

hindi: अश्व-व्यूह: उरस्य कवचधारी घोड़ों का, कक्ष और पक्ष बिना कवच के घोड़ों के।
english: The horse array: the centre of armoured (horses), the flank and wing of plain (unarmoured) ones.
notes: śuddha here = 'plain', without armour (contrast varmin); in 10.5.34 and 37 it means 'pure, unmixed'.

hindi: पत्ति-व्यूह: आगे ढाल-कवच वाले सैनिक, पीछे धनुर्धर।
english: The infantry array: in front the shield-bearers, behind the archers.
notes: āvaraṇin 'having a covering': men with shield or armour.

hindi: ये शुद्ध व्यूह हैं।
english: These are the pure (unmixed) arrays.

hindi: पैदल सैनिक दोनों पक्षों में, घोड़े दोनों पार्श्वों में, हाथी पीछे, रथ आगे; अथवा शत्रु के व्यूह के अनुसार इसका उलटा।
english: Foot-soldiers on the two wings, horses on the two sides, elephants behind, chariots in front; or a reversal according to the enemy's array.

words.gloss: division of forces with two arms

hindi: यह दो अंगों वाले बल का विभाग है।
english: This is the division of forces with two arms.
notes: dvi-aṅga 'two-limbed': arrays combining two of the four arms, as in 10.5.31-38 taken pairwise; literal rendering kept.

words.gloss: division of forces with three arms

hindi: उसी से तीन अंगों वाले बल का विभाग समझ लेना चाहिए।
english: By that the division of forces with three arms is explained.
notes: tr.aṅga is the e-text's writing of tryaṅga (tri + aṅga).

hindi: दण्ड की सम्पत् पुरुषों का सार-बल है।
english: The excellence of the army is a strong (picked) force of men.
notes: sāra 'essence, strength': sāra-bala = picked, strong troops; the term recurs in 10.5.43-51.

words.gloss: being in the prime of age

hindi: हाथियों और घोड़ों की विशेषता: कुल, जाति, सत्त्व, पूर्ण आयु में होना, प्राण-शक्ति, डील-डौल, वेग, तेज, प्रशिक्षण, स्थिरता, ऊँचा कद, आज्ञाकारिता, और शुभ लक्षण तथा अच्छा आचरण — ये हैं।
english: The distinction (excellence) of elephants and horses consists in: breed, stock, spirit, being in the prime of age, vitality, size, speed, mettle, training, steadiness, tall stature, docility, and good marks together with good behaviour.

text_flags.why: stairyam is not a Sanskrit word; sthairyam 'steadiness' (from sthira) fits the list; possible typo (th > t).

notes: suvyañjana-ācāratā taken as a dvandva 'good marks and (good) conduct'; it could also be read as one quality, 'conduct with good marks'.

words.gloss: of foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants

hindi: पैदल सैनिकों, घोड़ों, रथों और हाथियों में से सार बल का एक तिहाई उरस्य में खड़ा करे, दो तिहाई दोनों ओर कक्ष और पक्ष में; उसके बाद के बल को उसी क्रम में, तीसरे दर्जे के बल को उलटे क्रम में, और दुर्बल बल को उलटे क्रम में।
english: Of the foot-soldiers, horses, chariots and elephants he should station one third of the strong (troops) in the centre, two thirds in the flank and wing on both sides; the next-best in the same order, the third-best in reverse order, the weak in reverse order.
notes: anuloma/pratiloma: 'in the regular order' (a third in the centre, two thirds in the limbs) and 'in the reverse order' (two thirds in the centre, a third in the limbs). anusāra = the troops next in strength after sāra.

hindi: इस प्रकार वह सब कुछ उपयोग में ले आए।
english: Thus he should bring everything into use.

hindi: दुर्बल बल को सिरों पर रखकर यह वेग से आक्रमण करने वाला बन जाता है।
english: Having placed the weak force at the ends, it becomes one that makes a swift assault.
notes: abhihūlika is a rare word (from √hūl 'to strike, attack'); rendered 'making an assault'. The subject is the array (vyūha) understood. Reading and sense doubtful.

hindi: सार बल को आगे रखकर सिरों पर उसके बाद के बल को रखे, पिछले भाग में तीसरे दर्जे के बल को, और बीच में दुर्बल बल को।
english: Having placed the strong force in front, he should put the next-best at the tips, the third-best at the rear, and the weak force in the middle.

text_flags.why: tṛtiyiya is a typing error for tṛtīya 'third', as written in 10.5.43.

hindi: इस प्रकार यह सहनशील हो जाता है।
english: Thus this (array) becomes able to endure (an attack).

hindi: व्यूह खड़ा करके पक्ष, कक्ष और उरस्य में से एक या दो से प्रहार करे, और शेष से सहारा दे।
english: But having set up the array, he should strike with one or two of the wings, flanks and centre, and with the rest give support (hold in reserve).
notes: pratigṛhṇīyāt 'should receive, hold back': the reserve function, cf. pratigraha in 10.5.58.

words.gloss: in which secret instigation has been made

hindi: शत्रु का जो भाग दुर्बल हो, हाथी-घोड़ों से रहित हो, जिसके अमात्य दूष्य हों, या जिसमें उपजाप किया जा चुका हो, उस पर उससे अधिक सार बल से प्रहार करे।
english: Whatever (part) of the enemy is weak, devoid of elephants and horses, has treasonable ministers, or has had secret instigation made in it, that he should strike with strong troops exceeding it.
notes: The e-text joins tat into the compound tat-prabhūta-sāreṇa 'with strong troops more abundant than that'; alternatively tat is the correlative object 'that (part) he should strike with abundant strong troops'. Same sense either way. upajāpa = secret instigation to revolt.

hindi: अथवा शत्रु का जो भाग सबसे अधिक सारवान् हो, उस पर उससे दुगुने सार बल से प्रहार करे।
english: Or whatever (part) of the enemy is the strongest, that he should strike with strong troops twice that.

hindi: अपना जो अंग अल्प सार वाला हो, उसे बहुत से सैनिकों से पुष्ट करे।
english: Whichever arm of his own has little strength, that he should reinforce with many (troops).

hindi: जिस ओर से शत्रु की हानि हो सके, उस ओर निकट में व्यूह बनाए; अथवा जिस ओर से भय हो।
english: From which side the enemy's loss (would come), on that side he should array near by; or from which side there would be danger.

text_flags.why: yatot is not a form; yataḥ (sandhi yato before vā) parallel to yataḥ at the start of the line; stray t in the e-text.

notes: 'yato vā bhayaṃ syāt': he should also array near the side from which danger threatens.

hindi: आगे धावा करना, चारों ओर घूमना, आगे निकल जाना, पीछे हटना, मथकर दबाना, वलय, गोमूत्रिका, मण्डल, प्रकीर्णिका, पीठ फेरना, पंक्ति में पीछे-पीछे चलना, आगे से, दोनों पार्श्वों से और पीछे से आक्रमण, टूटी हुई सेना की रक्षा, टूटी हुई सेना का पीछा — ये अश्व-युद्ध हैं।
english: Charging forward, riding around, riding past, withdrawing, crushing and holding, the ring, the zigzag (go-mūtrikā), the circle, the scattered attack (prakīrṇikā), turning the back, following in column, (attack) from the front, from the two sides and from behind, protection of the broken troops, pursuit of the broken troops: these are the modes of cavalry fighting.
notes: Names of manoeuvres rendered literally: valaya 'bracelet/ring', go-mūtrikā 'cow's-urine line' (a zigzag), prakīrṇikā 'the scattered one', vyāvṛtta-pṛṣṭha 'with back turned' (wheeling about), anuvaṃśa 'along the line'. agrataḥ, pārśvābhyām, pṛṣṭhataḥ are directions of attack; unmathya-avadhāna 'having crushed, holding down' is uncertain.

hindi: प्रकीर्णिका को छोड़कर ये ही, चारों अंगों का — अलग-अलग या मिले हुए — विनाश, और पक्ष, कक्ष और उरस्य का तोड़ना, धावा, तथा सोते हुए शत्रु पर आक्रमण — ये हस्ति-युद्ध हैं।
english: These same, excluding the scattered attack, the destruction of the four arms separately or combined, and the smashing of the wings, flanks and centre, assault, and the night attack on the sleeping: these are the modes of elephant fighting.

text_flags.why: hasit is a transposition of hasti (elephant), cf. aśva.yuddhāni and ratha.yuddhāni in the parallel lines.

notes: The e-text divides prakīrṇika.āvarjāny; the word is prakīrṇikā-varjāni (prakīrṇikā + varja 'excluding'), split so here.

words.gloss: fighting while advancing, retreating and standing

hindi: मथकर दबाने को छोड़कर ये ही, तथा अपनी भूमि पर आगे बढ़ते हुए, पीछे हटते हुए और खड़े रहकर युद्ध करना — ये रथ-युद्ध हैं।
english: These same, excluding crushing and holding, and fighting while advancing, retreating and standing on one's own ground: these are the modes of chariot fighting.

words.gloss: striking in all places and times

hindi: सब स्थानों और सब समयों में प्रहार करना, तथा उपांशु-दण्ड — ये पत्ति-युद्ध हैं।
english: Striking in all places and at all times, and secret punishment (upāṃśu-daṇḍa): these are the modes of infantry fighting.
notes: daṇḍa here is 'punishment' (upāṃśu-daṇḍa, silent killing), not the army of the glossary.

hindi: इस विधि से वह ओज और युग्म व्यूह बनवाए, जब तक चारों अंगों के साधन उसके अनुरूप हों।
english: By this method he should have arrays made, odd and even, so long as the resources of the four arms would be adequate to them.
notes: Verse (anuṣṭubh). ojā/yugma = odd/even-numbered arrays (cf. 10.5.16, 19).

hindi: दो सौ धनुष पीछे जाकर राजा प्रतिग्रह में रहे; क्योंकि उसी से टूटी हुई सेना फिर जुटती है, इसलिए बिना प्रतिग्रह के युद्ध न करे।
english: Having gone two hundred bows (to the rear), the king should stay in the reserve; the rallying of the broken troops comes from that, (so) one without a reserve should not fight.
notes: Verse (anuṣṭubh). pratigraha = the reserve force (cf. pratigṛhṇīyāt 10.5.48). tasmāt taken with bhinna-saṅghātanam ('rallying of broken troops comes from it'); it could also be read as 'therefore' governing the second clause.
